purpose: Record a same-build low-overhead rerun that stopped making Range requests and whose in-page completion timer did not return. It is not a 600-second steady-state result.

conditions.instrumentation: Per-second rAF/rVFC aggregation without WebGL method wrapping; result was not returned.

observation.afterLastRequest: No further recorded-file Range request before manual interruption more than two minutes later. The active awaited Runtime.evaluate also did not return.
observation.excludedMetrics: The collector result was never returned, so rAF, rVFC, YADIF, and canvas values are unavailable and must not be inferred.

interpretation.conclusion: This incomplete run alone could not distinguish build behavior, cumulative device state, or a browser/GPU stall. A later completed low-overhead A/B reproduced progressive degradation with rank 7 and stayed stable when only rank 7 was removed.
interpretation.followup: See galaxy-present-one-field-long-run-ab.json; no rAF/rVFC values are inferred from this incomplete run.
